scope: Read-only authenticated browser inspection of actual production Apps Script. No setup, reminder or submission handler was manually invoked; no settings, deployments or Sheet data changed. Opening the bound Sheet can run its onOpen menu-only function.

source.method: Opened bound project from live Sheet Extensions > Apps Script; matched deployment ID; selected version 2 in Project History; copied source read-only; compared SHA256 after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Independently read Current version and appsscript.json.

scriptProperties.observed: Loaded Project Settings shows Add script property and no property/value rows. Read twice after navigation.
scriptProperties.spreadsheetResolution: Bound active spreadsheet fallback; no explicit TSG_LEADS_SPREADSHEET_ID property.

triggers.visibilityLimit: Trigger inventory is for the signed-in owner; other users' installable triggers require their own audit.

statusWrites.effect: Appends New Lead on initial rows; no cross-tab protected-status snapshot. doPost submission lock covers save only.
